verdict.rationale: Wise states that users can 'Lock in exactly what your recipient will get for up to 24 hours,' which covers locking a rate for a fixed window before the transfer completes. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, with no documentation of how the lock works. missing for 10: detailed docs on rate-lock mechanics (quote creation, expiry, API support), explicit confirmation that this applies to Wise Business accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can lock in an exchange rate for a fixed window before completing a transfer

citations.quote: Lock in exactly what your recipient will get for up to 24 hours. If the rate drops, you won’t lose out.
